articles.summary: Austin Gold Corp. was founded in 2020 to focus on gold exploration in Nevada. The Austin Gold team has been instrumental in building several mining successes in the past, including Pretium (“PVG”), SSR Mining (“SSRM”), and Uranerz Energy (acquired by Energy Fuels “UUUU”). Two of those mining companies have multi-billion-dollar market capitalizations.
articles.title: Austin Gold Reports Results of CSAMT Survey and Advances Drill Targeting at Stockade Mountain
